steps.title: Main Dashboard Graph
steps.body: This is the main Trellis Dashboard Graph — you'll see this same graph on many of the reports in Trellis. Hover over any date to see the variety of metrics available.

steps.title: Date Selector
steps.body: You can adjust the date range of this graph by using the Date Selector. Pick any date range you'd like, and compare to any other dates you'd like. Try clicking it now!

steps.title: Customize Your Metrics
steps.body: If you would like to change any of the metrics on the Dashboard, that can be found by clicking these three buttons. From there you can add any metrics you'd like!

steps.title: Welcome to Your Ad
steps.body: This is your Individual Ad page — your command center for a single campaign. Here you can view performance, manage targets, and configure every aspect of how this ad runs. Let's take a quick tour of what's available.

steps.title: Products
steps.body: The Products tab shows you all of the products included in this ad campaign. You can see each product's performance metrics, review which ASINs are actively being advertised, and manage your product selection.

steps.title: Keyword Targets
steps.body: The Keyword Targets tab shows all of the keywords and negative keywords in this campaign, along with their individual bids and performance metrics. This is where Trellis manages and optimizes your keyword targeting.

steps.title: Product Targets
steps.body: The Product Targets tab shows your ASIN and category targets, along with any negative targets. Use this to see where Trellis is targeting your ads at the product level and how each target is performing.

steps.title: Placement Report
steps.body: The Placement Report shows you exactly where your ad is appearing — top of search, product pages, rest of search — and the individual metrics for each placement. Great for understanding where your spend is going.

steps.title: Search Term Report
steps.body: The Search Term Report shows the actual customer search queries that triggered this campaign, along with their metrics and trends. This is one of the most powerful views for understanding what is and isn't working.

steps.title: Configuration
steps.body: The Configuration tab is where all of your campaign settings live — budget, ACOS targets, optimization strategy, bid ranges, and much more. This tab has its own dedicated tour. Head there and launch the Page Tour from the Trellis Help panel to get a full walkthrough!

steps.title: Welcome to Configuration
steps.body: You're now in the Configuration tab — your control center for every aspect of how this campaign operates. The left sidebar is your navigation menu. Let's walk through each section.

steps.title: Media Plan
steps.body: The Media Plan section is the main settings panel for your campaign. Here you define your campaign title, optimization strategy, ACOS range targets, daily budget, which products are included, and your targeting setup. This is where most of your day-to-day configuration lives.

steps.title: Advanced Options
steps.body: Within the Media Plan section, the Advanced Options accordion reveals powerful controls: Discovery & Harvesting, Optimization Strategy, Match Types, Bid Ranges, Amazon bidding options, and more. These give you fine-grained control over how Trellis manages your campaign.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.body: The Notifications section lets you set up performance alerts for this campaign. Configure triggers for events like ACOS exceeding a threshold or spend going over a limit — so you and your team are proactively notified when something needs attention.

steps.title: Rules
steps.body: Rules let you create custom automation logic for your campaign. Set conditions and actions that override or supplement Trellis's default bidding behavior — for example, pausing keywords that exceed a certain CPA, or applying a bid modifier when a product goes out of stock.

steps.title: Harvesting Programs
steps.body: Harvesting Programs control how Trellis discovers and adds new keywords and ASINs to your campaign. Set the thresholds for when a search term gets harvested, and customize the logic for how newly discovered targets are managed after they're added.

steps.title: Weekday Parting
steps.body: Weekday Parting lets you set bid multipliers based on the day of the week. If your products consistently perform better on certain days, you can increase or decrease bids accordingly to maximize your return on ad spend.

steps.title: Dayparting
steps.body: Dayparting gives you hourly bid multipliers across a 24-hour schedule. Use your campaign's hourly performance data to increase bids during peak-converting hours and reduce them during off-peak times — maximizing efficiency throughout the day.

steps.title: Serving Hours
steps.body: Serving Hours lets you restrict when your ads are eligible to run. If you only want ads active during specific windows — for example, during business hours when your team can fulfill orders — you can set those restrictions here.

steps.title: Scheduled Updates
steps.body: Scheduled Updates let you plan future configuration changes in advance. Schedule budget increases for a product launch, ACOS adjustments ahead of a promo period, or strategy switches — all without needing to be online when the change takes effect.

steps.title: History
steps.body: The History section is a complete log of every change made to this campaign — by you, your team, or Trellis automatically. Use it to audit changes, understand why performance shifted on a given date, and track who made what modifications.
